name: Constructive baseline
description: Use the constructive starting solution supplied by the problem adapter.
implementationNotes: Native candidate encoding; problem-defined construction, neighborhood and deployment score.

name: Random search
description: Sample independent candidates, retaining the best valid solution.
implementationNotes: Native candidate encoding; problem-defined construction, neighborhood and deployment score.

name: Hill climbing
description: Improve a solution through the problem-defined neighborhood.
implementationNotes: Native candidate encoding; problem-defined construction, neighborhood and deployment score.

name: Simulated annealing
description: Accept some temporary decreases while retaining the best solution.
implementationNotes: Native candidate encoding; problem-defined construction, neighborhood and deployment score.

name: Multistart hill climbing
description: Restart local improvement from independently sampled candidates.
implementationNotes: Uses the problem-defined native neighborhood and deployment score.

name: Tabu search
description: Explore sampled moves with short-term memory and best-score aspiration.
implementationNotes: Uses the problem-defined native neighborhood and deployment score.

name: Real-coded GA
description: Tournament selection, bounded SBX crossover, polynomial mutation and elitist survival.
implementationNotes: Bounded core implementation on the problem-provided normalized encoding. Default populations are adapted to the interactive budget; this is not an official CEC competition submission.

name: (1+1)-ES
description: Gaussian mutations with step-size adaptation using a one-fifth success window.
implementationNotes: Bounded core implementation on the problem-provided normalized encoding. Default populations are adapted to the interactive budget; this is not an official CEC competition submission.

name: DE/rand/1/bin

implementationNotes: Bounded core implementation on the problem-provided normalized encoding. Default populations are adapted to the interactive budget; this is not an official CEC competition submission.

name: DE/best/1/bin
description: Differential mutation around the current best vector.

name: jDE
description: Self-adapt the scale factor and crossover rate on each retained individual.
implementationNotes: Bounded core implementation on the problem-provided normalized encoding. Default populations are adapted to the interactive budget; this is not an official CEC competition submission.

name: JADE

name: Keep initial network
description: Build the common initial network and never edit it. A zero-edit reference.

name: Greedy extensions
description: When stations open, insert unconnected stops with the smallest extra route length.

name: Rebuild and search
description: Rebuild from a greedy plan every 30 minutes or when stations open, then search using a short demand forecast.

name: Budgeted local repair
description: Keep the current plan as a warm start. Test small repairs, with at most 12 edit units per decision.

name: Attack-move
description: Advance toward the nearest enemy and let each unit acquire targets locally.
reasons: Requires squad-policy/v1; this problem exposes optimization/v1, vector-optimization/v1, metro-policy/v1

name: Focus fire
description: Concentrate the squad on one target, balancing distance, health and threat.
reasons: Requires squad-policy/v1; this problem exposes optimization/v1, vector-optimization/v1, metro-policy/v1

name: Kite & focus
description: Focus fire, then use weapon cooldown windows to create distance with ranged units.
reasons: Requires squad-policy/v1; this problem exposes optimization/v1, vector-optimization/v1, metro-policy/v1

name: Random orders
description: A deliberately simple reference: alternate random nearby movement and enemy targeting.
reasons: Requires squad-policy/v1; this problem exposes optimization/v1, vector-optimization/v1, metro-policy/v1
